practice_questions.question_text: Construct a 3NF schema for these facts. Each asset has AssetID, label and model, and one current certificate recording issue date and issuing technician. Each technician has TechID, name and phone. An asset can have many inspections. Each inspection has InspectionID, date, valid-until date, inspecting technician and one standard. A standard has StandardID, title and authority. Show primary and foreign keys.
practice_questions.adaptation_rationale: Original application rewritten to be self-contained; assessed reasoning retained within cited 2027 scope.
practice_questions.solution: TECH(TechID PK, Name, Phone); ASSET(AssetID PK, Label, Model); CERTIFICATE(AssetID PK/FK→ASSET, IssueDate, IssuerID FK→TECH); STANDARD(StandardID PK, Title, Authority); INSPECTION(InspectionID PK, AssetID FK→ASSET, InspectorID FK→TECH, StandardID FK→STANDARD, InspectionDate, ValidUntil).

marking_points.criterion: Separate TECH and ASSET tables with their own descriptive attributes.
Separate CERTIFICATE table for certificate-specific facts.
Separate STANDARD table storing title and authority once.
Separate INSPECTION event table.
Correct stable primary keys, including one certificate per asset.
Correct certificate→asset and issuer→TECH foreign keys.
Correct inspection→asset, TECH and STANDARD foreign keys.
Event dates belong to inspections; no repeated groups or duplicated technician/standard descriptions.
